verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a Python scripting API and AppleScript support, so an API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference or runnable examples. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec, no llms.txt and no markdown docs. The existence of an API is not an interactive, runnable reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
